Container.Name: CineRename
Container.Overview: CineRename is a fast, automated media renamer and organizer built with Rust. It monitors your incoming downloads folder and automatically parses, matches (via TheTVDB, TVmaze, AniList & Kitsu), renames, and moves movies, TV shows, anime, and subtitles directly into clean Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby media libraries.

Config.Name: Media Inbox (Watch Folder)
Config.Description: Path to your incoming downloads folder.

Config.Name: Media Library (Destination)
Config.Description: Path to your organized media library (Plex / Jellyfin root).

Config.Name: OpenSubtitles API Key (Optional)
Config.Description: Optional OpenSubtitles API Key for subtitle fetching.
